name: Aries
couplet: Run, run, before they come and find you,
Grow up 'til you're taught to fight back.

name: Taurus
couplet: No need to flee, though the world's gaze is unkind,
I bear it all, willingly resigned.

name: Gemini
couplet: I've heard the whispers of your heart,
But they no longer hold their part.

name: Cancer
couplet: Emotions fall like rain, unending and fraught,
The more I ponder, the more tangled my thoughts.

name: Leo
couplet: I lack all gentleness,
Yet hold this lone courage.

name: Virgo
couplet: Let the soul remain fragmented,
Until one distant year, when pain engulfs again.

name: Libra
couplet: It's hard to balance restless fluctuations,
Hard to forgive the heart's constant wavering.

name: Scorpio
couplet: A dream within a dream,
One I can never wake from.

name: Sagittarius
couplet: My sword,
Where shall it roam?

name: Capricorn
couplet: So suffer your fate, Oh,
Come here and give me a hug.

name: Aquarius
couplet: With me you wander, no end in sight,
Drifting freely through day and night.

name: Pisces
couplet: The great fish swims through the seams of dreams,
Gazing upon the silhouette of your slumber.
